decision: owner decision 2026-11-09 (seventeenth set, docs/migration/reviews/owner_decisions_2026-11-03.md): "we should only allow free models via CBORG at the moment"
source: CBORG models page (https://cborg.lbl.gov/models), LBL-hosted models priced $0 per token
notes: Edit this file to change the policy; no code change is needed (F2W_MODEL_POLICY_FILE points at another copy).
A bare id (cborg-chat, gpt-oss-120b) is the same model as its lbl/ form; both spellings are accepted.
An id with another provider prefix (openai/, anthropic/, google/, amazon/, ...) is never free and is refused.
When the live CBORG listing carries a price for a model, the model is allowed only if that price is 0.
